Hong Wang, Silver Professor of Mathematics, was awarded the Fields Medal—mathematic's highest honor—at the 2026 International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Courant's Applied Mathematics Laboratory publishes breakthrough research on melting icebergs
Leif Ristroph, Associate Professor of Mathematics, and his team in the Applied Mathematics Laboratory have identified factors that cause icebergs to capsize in a new paper published by Physical Review Fluids.

Yann LeCun accepts the Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering
Yann LeCun, Jacob T. Schwartz Chaired Professor of Computer Science, received the 2025 Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering from King Charles III during a ceremony at St. James Palace in London.

Denis Yarats selected as the Keynote Speaker at NYU Entrepreneurs Festival
Denis Yarats, former Courant PhD student and Co-Founder of Perplexity AI, served as the featured keynote speaker at the 14th Annual NYU Entrepreneurs Festival.

Laure Zanna to lead NYU's new Earth Systems Institute
The new multidisciplinary hub—led by Courant Professor Laure Zanna—will deploy AI and computational tools to better predict environmental changes and prepare our responses.

Subhash Khot joins IBM Research as Senior Mathematician
Subhash Khot will join IBM Research as a Senior Mathematician in a dual appointment with the Courant Institute School of Mathematics, Computing, and Data Science, where he will remain Silver Professor of Computer Science.

Courant has announced its new flagship journal the Courant Journal of Pure and Applied Mathematics (CPAM) will begin publication in early 2027.

Romain Lopez and Juan Carlos Perdomo Selected as AI Fellows by Schmidt Sciences
Romain Lopez, Associate Professor of Computer Science and Biology, and Juan Carlos Perdomo, Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Data Science, were named among Schmidt Sciences’ fifth cohort of AI2050 Fellows. Read More
Tristan Buckmaster Constructs Finite-Time Blowup for 3D Euler with Smooth Forcing
Tristan Buckmaster, Professor of Mathematics, and collaborators announced their significant step towards the resolution of the Millennium problem for 3D Navier-Stokes. Read More
